Controls

  • Left click: grab and drag the plug (by its silver tip) or any object. You can lift things too.
  • Scroll while holding: up pushes it farther away, down brings it closer.
  • Hold right click and move the mouse: rotate what you're holding, in place. It keeps that rotation until you let go.
  • Near the port the plug snaps flat. Centre it, then push in. F flips the plug.
  • Empty space: left-drag slides the camera, right-drag turns it like turning your head, scroll moves straight forward/back. WASD / Q E also move, R resets.
